style.vernacular: A dense high-rise Chinese city around a Portuguese colonial core: pastel yellow, cream, pink and white colonial buildings with white mouldings, green shutters, arcades and clay-tile roofs, set on black-and-white calcada wave pavement; granite and grey-brick Cantonese temples and tenements; and slab residential towers in grey, white and tile cladding. On Cotai and Taipa the big integrated resorts are glass, steel and gold-themed mega-blocks. Banyan and palm planting, hillside and reclaimed-land waterfront.
style.ornament: Portuguese colonial white mouldings, quoins, pediments and green louvred shutters on yellow or pink facades; calcada portuguesa black-and-white wave paving; azulejo panels; granite gate pavilions and curved ridge ornaments on Chinese temples; grey-brick Cantonese tenements; gilded themed facades on the casino resorts.

sources.what: Macau architecture: Portuguese and Cantonese blend, A-Ma Temple granite and brick, Holy House of Mercy neoclassical with 14 arches, Mandarin's House with Art Deco touches, Grand Lisboa of steel, concrete and glass
